name: Orb-TS-TW
blurb: Glowing animated orb that distorts and rotates when the cursor hovers near it.
description: WebGL shader rendering a colorizable orb with Perlin noise-driven outer halo and inner core, responding to pointer proximity for distortion and optional rotation.
use_when: Decorative hero sections, call-to-action zones, or backgrounds where a luminous, reactive focal point enhances engagement.
avoid_when: WebGL-unsupported devices, touch-only surfaces, or performance-critical mobile contexts — the shader runs continuously.
a11y: Passive visual effect; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
